info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Operational Service Card Collection-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of operational service card collections in the banking sector. It enables users to create collections that can be used for various transactional and service-related purposes. Typical consumers include banking applications and service management systems that require efficient organization of service cards. With this API, developers can initiate the creation of card collections to streamline operational processes and enhance service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new card collection within the operational services. You must provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create the collection.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new card collection record. The supplied data must conform to the defined schema and contain all required fields for successful processing.
